result.title: Z-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers via Self-Reflection
result.summary: Diffusion transformers have become the most powerful models for visual generation, but still suffer from massive computation costs. To solve this problem, feature caching has been proposed to cache the features of diffusion models in the previous computation steps and then reuse them in the following caching steps, which brings significant acceleration but also degradation in generation quality. To address this problem, this paper proposes Z-cache as a feature caching method that can maintain high-quality generation through self-reflection. Concretely, we observe that the error from feature caching tends to be sharply reduced after each full computation. Based on this observation, Z-Cache is designed to first predict the features in the future caching steps and then perform a full computation. After that, Z-Cache returns to the caching steps and re-predicts them based on the previous and the current computation steps, which brings correction in features. Experiments demonstrate that with Z-Cache, diffusion transformers achieve comparable generation quality to the original model but with faster inference speed, for instance, 6.22X acceleration on FLUX-dev for text-to-image generation. Our code is released on GitHub.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Z-Cache，一种用于扩散 Transformer 视觉生成的特征缓存加速方法：先预测后续缓存步的特征并做一次完整计算，再回到这些步依据前后计算重预测以校正特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「低成本预测—周期性全计算—回溯校正」的误差控制范式，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的近似更新、漂移校正及 THINK/LOOK 的计算预算分配可供核查，但论文本身面向生成加速而非多模态推理。
